examples.description: Receive a delivery by item name (resolves the item, or creates it first)

failure_modes.recovery: Send { id | name, type, quantity }. Count whole units: 24 bags → 24 (the digit string "24" also works). type aliases: received/receive/add/restock/delivery/increase → in; sold/remove/used/waste/decrease → out. An ambiguous name refuses with the candidate ids — pass id instead.
failure_modes.when: type is not 'in'/'out' (or a listed alias), quantity is not a positive whole number, or the name matches multiple items

failure_modes.recovery: Call stock_item_list and pick a live item id.
failure_modes.when: the id names no ACTIVE item in your tenant (soft-deleted items refuse adjustment)

preconditions: No id? Pass name/item_name: a unique active match resolves; an unknown name CREATES the item at quantity 0 and the adjustment lands as its first ledger row; duplicate names refuse with the candidate ids.
Stock-out clamps at zero: adjusting 5 out of an item holding 3 applies 3 — the response carries applied_quantity so you can reconcile.
Every adjust writes one movements-ledger row atomically with the quantity move.

description: Move stock in or out by id or item name, in one atomic write with its movements-ledger row: stock-out clamps at zero (never negative) and applied_quantity reports what actually moved. An unmatched name CREATES the item at quantity 0 first so the delivery still lands as an audited ledger row; a name matching multiple active items refuses with the candidate ids. Concurrent adjusts on the same item retry instead of losing a write. NEXT: stock_item_list to see the item's updated balance in the full inventory.

name.description: No id? Resolve-or-create by item name: a unique active match resolves; an unknown name CREATES the item at quantity 0 and the adjustment lands as its first ledger row.

notes.description: Free-form note recorded on the movements-ledger row.

occurred_at.description: When the stock ACTUALLY moved (business time): "YYYY-MM-DD" or epoch milliseconds. Omitted = now. Backdated deliveries stay distinguishable from entry time.

quantity.description: Whole units — count whole units: 24 bags → 24 (the digit string "24" also works).

reason.description: Why the stock moved — recorded on the movements-ledger row.

type.description: "in" | "out" — also accepts received/delivery/restock (→ in) and sold/used (→ out).

name: stock_item_adjust
